auth.loginSubtitle: Use your manager account to continue.
auth.loginFailed: Sign in failed. Check your email and password.
auth.serviceUnavailable: Could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.scopeGlobal: Admin view: every instance and account is visible.
overview.scopeInstance: Account view: only this account's own instances are visible.

chart.title: New instances
chart.rangeNote: Counts instances loaded in range. Totals above come from the server.

recent.title: Recent instances
recent.empty: No instances yet. Create the first one to pair a phone.
recent.loadFailed: Could not load the recent instances.

overview.fallbackNotice: Live totals are unavailable. Showing counts from the loaded list.

instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitleUser: Only the instances owned by this account.
instances.empty: No instances yet. Create the first one to pair a phone.

actions.notConnected: Instance is not connected. Pair it before acting.

connect.pairingStarted: Pairing started. Scan the QR on the details page.

edit.title: Edit instance
edit.body: Rename {name} or change its external reference.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Use 1–64 ASCII letters or digits, with hyphens or underscores inside. Start and end with a letter or digit. Names are case-sensitive; stats and UUIDs are reserved.
fields.nameTaken: This instance name is already in use. Choose another name.
fields.externalRefHint: Optional unique reference used by your systems.
fields.externalRefWriteOnlyHint: Stored secret-style reference: it is never shown back. Leave empty to keep the current value; type a value to replace it.

create.title: New instance
create.body: The instance starts disconnected. Its API key is shown once after creation.
create.quotaExceeded: Instance quota exceeded. Nothing was created.
create.externalRefTaken: This external reference is already in use.
create.successBody: Copy the API key now. It will never be shown again.

detail.externalRefTaken: This external reference is already in use.
detail.disconnectConfirmBody: The paired phone is unlinked and the session ends. Pair again later to reconnect.

delete.title: Delete instance
delete.body: This permanently removes the instance {name} and its API key.

pairing.scanHint: Scan this QR code with WhatsApp on your phone to link this instance.
pairing.connectedBody: This instance is linked to {jid}. No further pairing is needed.
pairing.connectedBodyNoJid: This instance is linked. No further pairing is needed.
pairing.reissueFailed: Could not refresh the QR code. Trying again...

key.label: Instance API key
key.shownOnceBody: Copy the key now and store it somewhere safe. The service never shows it again.
key.keylessBody: This instance may predate API keys, or its key was revoked or lost. Generate a new key below. The previous key, if any, stops working immediately.
key.rotateHint: Generating a new key invalidates the current one immediately.
key.revokeConfirmBody: The current key stops working at once. The instance stays manageable from this console until a new key is generated.

webhook.urlHint: HTTPS anywhere; plain HTTP only for loopback hosts (localhost, 127.x, ::1). Empty unsets the webhook.
webhook.eventsHint: Only these types are delivered over HTTP; the rest stay on NATS. Unknown types are rejected.
webhook.noEventsBody: Nothing will be delivered until at least one type is selected.
webhook.urlRequired: Enter an http(s) URL to enable the webhook.

send.numberMissing: Number is not on WhatsApp. Nothing was queued.
send.resolutionUnavailable: Number resolution is unavailable. Try again later.
send.notConnected: Instance is not connected. Pair it before sending.
send.fileHint: Images, video, audio and documents are accepted. The declared type always matches the file content.
send.unsupportedFile: File type is not supported. Nothing was queued.
send.caption: Caption
send.filenameHint: Optional. Defaults to the uploaded file name.
send.settleTimeout: Still processing. Refresh the messages below for the latest status.
send.invalidLocation: Give a valid latitude (-90 to 90) and longitude (-180 to 180).
send.contactRequired: Give a display name and a vCard.
send.question: Question
send.optionsHint: One option per line, at least two.
send.pollRequired: Give a question and at least two options.
send.sectionsHint: One row per line as id | title.
send.listRequired: Give a title, a button label and at least one row.
send.buttonsRequired: Give a message text and at least one button.

messages.empty: No messages yet. Send a test message above.

pairPhone.connectFirst: Start pairing with Connect first, then request the code.
pairPhone.failed: Could not issue the pairing code.

groups.jidRequired: Enter a group JID before looking it up.
groups.name: Name
groups.inviteFailed: Could not load the invite code.
groups.photoHint: PNG or JPEG, sent as image/* octet-stream.
groups.photoFailed: Could not update the group photo.
groups.nameTooLong: Name must be 25 characters or fewer.
groups.reconcileInvite: Group created but the invite lookup failed. Fetch the invite below instead of creating again.
groups.empty: No groups loaded. Look one up by JID.

profile.name: Name
profile.photoHint: PNG or JPEG, sent as image/* octet-stream.
profile.photoFailed: Could not update the profile photo.
profile.recadoHint: Up to 500 characters. Empty clears it.
profile.unsupported: This upstream cannot apply this change.

privacy.groupsAdd: Who can add me to groups
privacy.saveFailed: Could not save the privacy settings.
privacy.loadFailed: Could not load the privacy settings.

settings.hint: Read-only snapshot from the connected phone. Blocks show Not set while the instance is disconnected or a value could not be loaded.
settings.defaultDisappearingFailed: Could not update the default timer
settings.defaultDisappearingHint: Echo of the last value accepted by the API for new chats; it may differ from the phone.

chatwoot.disabled: Chatwoot is disabled on this service. Configuration is unavailable.
chatwoot.saveFailed: Could not save the Chatwoot configuration.
chatwoot.loadFailed: Could not load the Chatwoot configuration.
chatwoot.tokenHint: Write-only. The stored token is never shown again.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Every manager account. Only admins see this screen.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Create the first client account.

create.title: New account
create.body: The account signs in with email and password. Quota 0 means unlimited.
create.quotaInvalid: Quota must be a whole number 0 or above, or left empty for the default.
create.quotaHint: Whole number 0 or above; empty applies the server default. 0 means unlimited.
create.emailTaken: This email is already in use.

quota.title: Edit quota
quota.body: Set the instance quota for {email}. 0 means unlimited.
quota.hint: Whole number 0 or above. 0 means unlimited.
quota.quotaInvalid: Quota must be a whole number 0 or above.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.ownsInstances: This account still owns instances. Remove its instances first.
delete.selfBlocked: You cannot delete your own account.

bulkDelete.title: Delete selected accounts
bulkDelete.body: This permanently removes {count} accounts. Your own account is always skipped; owners that still own instances fail and are kept.
bulkDelete.partial: {deleted} deleted, {failed} failed. Owners with instances were kept.
bulkDelete.selfSkipped: Only your own account was selected. Nothing was deleted.
